thread:
paul: Quick proposal: ship a tightly scoped observability "launch kit" for Console by end of Q2. Keep it low-risk: focused dashboards, cheap traces, and a cost reconciliation check.

sara: Love the focus. What are the absolute must-haves?

paul: Must-haves: (1) three dashboards: latency (p50/p95) by route, cost by model+route, errors by service + code; (2) one sampling-based tracing hook with trace_id propagation and easy link-to-trace from UI; (3) a cost reconciliation job and a short customer doc explaining cost lines.

kim: For tracing, baseline sampling 0.5%, force-sample on errors, and per-route overrides. Implement sampling decision in the edge to minimize runtime overhead.

michael: Runtime note: synchronous span writes hurt tail latency. Plan: async batched export with max_flush_ms=180 and a compact span payload. Example: `tracing.max_flush_ms=180`, `tracing.sample_pct=0.5`.

zara: Data infra: hourly pre-aggregation of cost metrics, 30d retention for v1. We'll provide a sandbox dataset for reconciliation. Acceptance: model buckets within 12% of billing sandbox.

sara: Alerts: cost week-over-week >20% and error-rate spike > threshold. Alerts should include runbook link and suggested mitigations (downgrade model, enable caching).

paul: Customer ask captured: quick before/after cost comparison when swapping models, cost drilldown by route, and trace links from error spikes. Prioritize cost comparison + alerting for launch; full trace drilldown can be post-launch.

kim: Engineering estimate: 3 engineer-weeks to add route tags + edge sampling + async exporter if we exclude websocket streaming. Recommend excluding websockets for v1.

michael: SRE perf guardrail: enabling tracing in canary must not increase p99 by >5ms. SRE to run stress test with tracing enabled.

zara: Action items: Data (zara) provide QA dataset by Wed; Eng (kim) post RFC with metric names + sampling algorithm by Thu; SRE (michael) deliver perf test plan by Mon; Product (paul) draft customer doc by Fri.

deploy-bot: Canary window reserved: 2026-05-28 01:00-03:00 UTC; rollout 2026-05-29 02:00-05:00 UTC.

paul: I'll coordinate RFC and confirm launch notes (explicitly call out websocket deferral). Reactions: :rocket: :white_check_mark:
